original_sentence: The restaurant industry is currently suffering a severe shortage of skilled chefs—a deficit of 11,000, according to the skills agency People 1st.
translation: 餐饮业目前正遭遇熟练厨师严重短缺；据技能机构 People 1st 称，缺口达 1.1 万人。

skilled chefs 在本句中对应"熟练厨师"。
